set.body:
Reuse Studio S4 graphics and S9 figures/export. This workstream owns comparative coverage and evidence, not a second plotting stack.

Acceptance:
- Freeze identical datasets, scientific transformations and display conventions for a gallery covering stimulus scanpaths, raw/velocity/pupil traces and event overlays, occupancy/heatmaps, AOIs/reading, main sequence, data-loss/quality, and study comparisons (contrasts, multiscale and temporal views where applicable).
- Common plots have a usable library route without launching Studio. The real Studio backend supports linked selection/inspection with explicit freshness/provenance; placeholders or synthetic-only screens do not qualify the complete workflow.
- Correct units, extents, axis direction, duration encoding, density normalization, comparable scales, event boundaries and uncertainty where scientifically available. Distinguish order connections from measured saccades; show missing/off-screen data and admission decisions honestly.
- Independent, preferably blinded review on fixed specimens compares scientific correctness, legibility, useful information, typography/layout, accessibility and task success. Freeze scoring and practical superiority thresholds first. Any scientific misrepresentation fails regardless of aesthetic scores; retain raw judgments, disagreements, ties and losses.
- Verify SVG/PDF/PNG exports at paper/presentation sizes, standalone reproducibility, light/dark/HiDPI rendering and keyboard/accessibility behavior. Exported numbers trace to the same saved result/specification used in the interactive view. Meet linked responsiveness budgets.

Create bounded plot-family or interaction repair slices after specimen review. Existing board-parity approval is useful evidence but does not substitute for same-data scientific and publication-quality comparison.
set.title: PM4: deliver superior same-data figures and real interactive analysis
